caption: Berenice Abbott, Seventh Avenue looking south from 35th Street (1935)
alt: A black-and-white photograph looking straight down a long Manhattan avenue from high above: dark skyscrapers on both sides, and a sunlit street crowded with cars and buses narrowing into the haze.
bibliography: Abbott, Berenice. Seventh Avenue Looking South from 35th Street. 1935, New York Public Library Digital Collections.
